name: Blood Ties
description: Blood Ties is a Canadian television series based on the Blood Books by Tanya Huff; the show was created by Peter Mohan. It is set in Toronto, Canada and has a similar premise to an earlier series also set in Toronto, Forever Knight, in which a vampire assists police in dealing with crime. It premiered in the United States on March 11, 2007 on Lifetime Television, and during fall of 2007 on Citytv and Space in Canada. In May 2008, Lifetime declined to renew the series.

videos.title: Blood Price (1)
videos.overview:
One late evening Vicki witnesses a gruesome murder – except because of her bad sight, she’s not really sure what she saw. She itches to get back to what she does best, solving crimes, but her old colleague, police detective Mike Cellucci warns her against getting involved. Meanwhile, Henry Fitzroy, a vampire living in Toronto, also decides to look into the murders lest they be blamed on a vampire – himself for example. 

Vicki and Henry team up to solve the case and Vicki aquires an assistant, Coreen Fennel.

videos.title: Blood Price (2)
videos.overview: After teaming up with Henry Fitzroy, it's up to Vicki and Henry to find out who raised this demon.

videos.title: Bad JuJu
videos.overview: After being attacked by a zombie, Vicki finds out that a voodoo priest has put death on her.

videos.title: Gifted
videos.overview: A young girl has telekintic powers that controls a demon. Meanwhile Mike is on the hunt to find out who Henry really is.

videos.title: Deadly Departed
videos.overview: A vengeful spirit and a witch is on the loose and their next target is close to Vicki and Mike.

videos.title: Love Hurts
videos.overview: A man hires Vicki to figure out if his wife is cheating on him. After she is found dead, the man is the prime suspect.

videos.title: Heart of Ice
videos.overview: Homeless people have gone missing. Vicki gets more then she bargained for when she tries to solve the case. Mike is on another case where a hooker's blood has  been drained and Henry is number one on his list of suspects.

videos.title: Heart of Fire
videos.overview: Henry is held hostage by some from his past, but can Mike and Vicki get along in time to save Henry.

videos.title: Stone Cold
videos.overview: Vicki and Henry have a run in with Medusa, the gorgon of Greek lore. While looking for a missing male model.

videos.title: Necrodrome
videos.overview: The dead body of pro boxer Diesel Swanson has gone missing. Things get weird when a tape shows Diesel getting up and walking out of the funeral home.

videos.title: Post Partum
videos.overview: A man hires Vicki to check on his wife is who isolated in a clinic.

videos.title: Norman
videos.overview: Norman is back from hell and is ready, yet again to bring back his demonic master.

videos.title: D.O.A.
videos.overview: A former co-worker of Vicki and Mike. Comes to Vicki for help in his own murder downside Vicki can only see him.

videos.title: Wild Blood
videos.overview: The woman that Mike arrested is charged for a murder, but the way the wounds come out,she couldn't have done it. Vicki and Henry find out the woman's true self.

videos.title: Five: fifty-five
videos.overview: Vicki keeps waking up on the same day and time with a chain of events happening over and over again.

videos.title: Bugged
videos.overview: Coreen asks Vicki to check out a string of murders at a goth club. The victims looked like they had been killed by bugs.

videos.title: The Devil You Know
videos.overview: Henry takes steps to protect Vicki and Mike from the vampire who's encroaching upon his territory: his sire and ex-lover, Christina.

videos.title: Drawn and Quartered
videos.overview: Henry's friend is killed and Vicki is on the case. Dragged into the world of art she finds out that the victim might have been killed by a curse from the grave.

videos.title: Wrapped
videos.overview: A mummy is back from the dead and needs life energy to stay alive, so the mummy goes after the one person that will keep him alive forever.

videos.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
videos.overview: A jailed killer calls up Vicki and tells her that he has had visions of another murder that is about to occur. He also proclaims his innocence for the past murder.

videos.title: We'll Meet Again
videos.overview: A boy hires Vicki to find his soul mate, who he's been with for every generation. She starts to think he's crazy and also questions her own sanity.

videos.title: Deep Dark
videos.overview:
Coreen is possessed by a demon, who wants to use her to get to Vicky. Vicky must make a choice that could imperil her soul. Mike gets in more trouble at work because of his association with Vicky and Henry finalizes his arrangements to move to Vancouver.
